payload.tension: The passage states slavery changes masters and outcomes. What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be! For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
